scientific_integrity: The theorem and its proof are in RESULT.md. Verification uses a symbolic profile checker and independent exhaustive three-round games on finite representatives. Independently reviewed status is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Pure adjacency/equality only; no named coordinates or counting, and rank exactly up to three. The sharp 12-vertex bound is internal to the categorical-product family. Exhaustive finite checks are not proofs of the infinite theorem; unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
title: Seven rank-three theories of categorical products of complete graphs
